# Bundled assets

## FrequencyWords / OpenSubtitles2018
Source: https://github.com/hermitdave/FrequencyWords/tree/master/content/2018
Author/publisher: Hermit Dave; corpus: OpenSubtitles2018 (OPUS).
Content license: CC BY-SA 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
The upstream README distinguishes the MIT code license from the CC BY-SA content license; both upstream files are included here.
Changes: lowercase normalization, language-character filtering, 1–22 character limit, duplicate removal, merging bundled fallback words, frequency sorting, taking 250,000 Russian and 200,000 English entries. These derived dictionary assets remain CC BY-SA 4.0.
Retrieved 2026-11-25. Exact bundled bytes are fixed by ../assets.sha256; no downloads occur during normal builds.

## Tesseract tessdata_fast
Source: https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast
Files: rus.traineddata, eng.traineddata, unmodified, retrieved 2026-11-25.
License: Apache License 2.0 (ocr-license.txt).
Checksums: ../assets.sha256.
